bootstrap.headline_fixed_suite: all planned datasets retained and equally weighted in every replicate; subjects resampled within dataset
bootstrap.separate_dataset_superpopulation_sensiti: datasets then subjects resampled; different superpopulation estimand
bootstrap.unit: paired subject cluster after fold concatenation and seed averaging

inference_policy: no null-hypothesis tests or model-selection decisions are produced; all model-minus-TCFormer bootstrap intervals are explicitly descriptive
interpretation: exploratory results on opened development cohorts; not confirmation evidence, not a global/SOTA claim

metric_definitions.balanced_accuracy: unadjusted mean recall over observed true classes
metric_definitions.chance_normalized_balanced_accuracy: (balanced_accuracy - 1/K) / (1 - 1/K), using each dataset's planned class count K
metric_definitions.ece: top-label ECE with 15 equal-width confidence bins
metric_definitions.macro_f1: macro F1 over the plan class set; zero for undefined class F1
metric_definitions.multiclass_brier: mean sum of squared class-probability errors
metric_definitions.nll: mean negative log probability of the true class; clipped at 1e-15
metric_definitions.ovr_macro_auroc: mean one-vs-rest class AUROC only when every class has both positive and negative examples

primary_metric.definition: concatenate disjoint folds within subject/seed; average seeds within subject, subjects within dataset, then equally weight datasets
primary_metric.name: equal-dataset macro balanced accuracy

ranking_warning: the leader is outcome-ranked from all 43 common models on these opened development cohorts; it is not a confirmatory or SOTA result
trial_micro_warning: trial-micro rows pool repeated seed predictions and weight subjects/datasets by trial count; cross-dataset BA/F1/kappa/AUROC are undefined
